title: YUNGs-API issue #8: Fabric cannot find API
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (LGPL-3.0) does not cover issue text
text:
[issue by FabricStuff]
When I launch Minecraft Fabric, I get a crash issue that says it "Could not find required mod: yungsapi requires {fabric @ [>=0.25.0]}". But I already have the latest ver. installed to my mods folder.

[comment by yungnickyoung (member)]
Double check. That is a message from the fabric loader itself, not my mod. So you may have accidentally downloaded the wrong version, or not placed it in your mods folder.
